description: List every standing bid on the Branch license auction of The Standard Reserve (TSR), on Robinhood Chain, read at one block. A bid is a standing order on a charter: a count (1 to 3) and a maximum unit price. Nothing is escrowed; a fill is paid from the charter's pending STANDARD, and fill() is a separate transaction that anyone may send. Each bid carries the contract's own fillable answer, the checks behind it, and a blocking list naming every failing check (price above max, daily supply used up, charter window or branch cap, insufficient pending, owner changed, charter burned). Stale bids are flagged and prunable. effective_crossing_price_raw is derived, and the response states its assumption. Bidder addresses are public chain state and are included. Optional charter_id, bidder, fillable_only and sort (max_desc or charter_id). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings. It returns facts only and does not recommend an action.

bidder.description: Only bids placed by this 0x address.

charter_id.description: Only this charter's bid. An empty bids list means it has none.

fillable_only.description: Drop bids the contract does not currently report as fillable (default false).

sort.description: max_desc (default) sorts by descending max unit price; charter_id sorts ascending.

name: 1s_std_license_bids
title: TSR License Auction Bids
